title: Sloth holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="balloon" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff7eb3"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d6275a"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d="M 62 38 Q 60 55 55 65 Q 52 72 50 78" stroke="#e8d8b0" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="28" rx="12" ry="14" fill="url(#balloon)"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="24" rx="4" ry="6" fill="#ffb3d1" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M 62 42 L 60 46 L 64 46 Z" fill="#c41e4a"/>
  <!-- Sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="72" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#a0785a"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="74" rx="14" ry="12" fill="#c4a37a"/>
  <!-- Sloth head -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="48" rx="16" ry="14" fill="#b08a62"/>
  <!-- Face mask -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="50" rx="10" ry="9" fill="#e8d8b0"/>
  <!-- Eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="47" rx="4" ry="3.5" fill="#5a3e2b"/>
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="47" rx="4" ry="3.5" fill="#5a3e2b"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="47" r="1.8" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="47" r="1.8" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="33.5" cy="46.3" r="0.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="46.3" r="0.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="51" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#4a3020"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M 35 54 Q 38 57 41 54" stroke="#4a3020" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="43" r="5" fill="#b08a62"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="43" r="2.5" fill="#d4b48c"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="43" r="5" fill="#b08a62"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="43" r="2.5" fill="#d4b48c"/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <!-- Left arm (down) -->
  <path d="M 26 62 Q 22 72 24 82" stroke="#a0785a" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right arm (up holding string) -->
  <path d="M 52 62 Q 56 56 58 52" stroke="#a0785a" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Claws on right arm -->
  <path d="M 56 52 L 59 50 M 58 53 L 61 52 M 57 51 L 60 48" stroke="#d4b48c" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Claws on left arm -->
  <path d="M 23 81 L 21 84 M 25 82 L 24 85 M 26 81 L 27 84" stroke="#d4b48c" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="75" rx="9" ry="8" fill="#d4b48c"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="88" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#a0785a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#a0785a"/>
</svg>
